The '''1973–74 Serie A''' season was won by [[S.S. Lazio|Lazio]].

==Teams==
[[Genoa C.F.C.|Genoa]], [[AC Cesena|Cesena]] and [[US Foggia|Foggia]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
